evidence.description: A heavy iron key, tarnished by river water. It fits the wards of the old mill house — and it was never on the miller's ring the night he vanished.
evidence.name: Rusted Key

evidence.description: The miller's last entry reads: 'They told me not to look at the river at night. I looked.' His handwriting trails off mid-word.
evidence.name: Old Miller's Journal

knowledge.description: The old miller vanished without a trace ten years ago. The case was never solved. Villagers avoid the topic.
knowledge.title: The Disappearance

knowledge.description: Sixty years ago, a fire destroyed the northern quarter of the village. Official records say it was a chimney accident, but old stories mention something else.
knowledge.title: The Great Fire
